description: This file defines the MacNodeLocationService class in Swift, which manages location services using CoreLocation. It provides async functions to fetch current location with optional timeout management, handles location updates, and manages errors, acting as a location service component for macOS applications.

classes.name: MacNodeLocationService
classes.description: A Swift class that manages macOS location services asynchronously, handling location updates, errors, and timeouts, conforming to CLLocationManagerDelegate and LocationServiceCommon.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current location, considering desired accuracy, maximum age, and timeout parameters.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous operation with a specified timeout, canceling it if it exceeds the limit.
